methodology.cold: first Run of a new JIT in a fresh process
methodology.warm: eight subsequent Runs of the same JIT; includes engine tiering; all retained
methodology.sampleIndex: runIndex is 0 for cold and 1..8 for warm Runs in execution order

tiering.eventReason: Node/V8 exposes no portable completion event for inner WASM module optimization

methodology.aggregation: median of process warm medians; cold phase totals exclude guest execution
methodology.timing: Run wall time includes profile snapshot if enabled; excludes reset/validation
